Per the rules: a request to change training because the lower back is complaining is a limitation request, not a damage description. "Could today's workout skip the heavy pulls" maps to limitations: ["lower_back"], and no comment about the back itself. The athlete says "nothing crazy," so it is soreness-level, which keeps this a patch.

{"route": "patch", "say": "Got it, we'll keep heavy pulls off your plate while your lower back settles.", "patch": {"limitations": ["lower_back"]}}
